faqs.question: When do most full marathons happen in Vietnam?
faqs.answer: November is the busiest month with three races, including the Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race, the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon, and the VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight. October and December each have two, while August opens the season with races in Huế and Nha Trang.

faqs.question: Which city has the most full marathon options?
faqs.answer: Hanoi hosts the most events on this list, with four separate races: the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon in October, the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon also in October, the Standard Chartered Hanoi Marathon Heritage Race in November, and the VnExpress Marathon Hanoi Midnight later that same month.

faqs.question: Do these marathons all offer the same race distances?
faqs.answer: All eleven include a 42.195km (or 42km) full marathon alongside a half marathon, but the shorter companion distances differ. Some, like the Techcombank races, add 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km options, while others such as the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon offer only the full and half distances.
